\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Random Variables --- Symmetric: Introduction}
Symmetry sharpens affine contraction estimates. The fourth-moment case has an exact radius criterion, while every higher finite moment gives an explicit sufficient radius.

\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Random Variables --- Symmetric: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Symmetric fourth-moment criterion]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.symmetric_hypercontractive_four_iff}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsSymmetricRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm}
\difficulty{7}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ have the same
distribution as $-X$, and suppose $X\in L^4(\mu)$. Assume its real-valued $L^2$ and
$L^4$ norms satisfy $N_2(X)=1$ and $N_4(X)=C$ with $C>0$. For $0\le\rho<1$, $X$ is
$(2,4,\rho)$-hypercontractive if and only if $\rho\le\min\{1/\sqrt3,1/C\}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Symmetric hypercontractivity from a higher norm]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.symmetric_hypercontractive}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsSymmetricRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_affine_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_rpow, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.two_point_rpow_le}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p279-b001}
\difficulty{6}
Let $q>2$ and let $X\in L^q$ have a symmetric law on a probability space, with $\|X\|_2=1$ and $\|X\|_q=C>0$. Then $H_{2,q,\rho}(X)$ holds for $\rho=1/(C\sqrt{q-1})$. Write $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$ for $1\le p\le q\le\infty$, $0\le\rho<1$, $X\in L^q(\mu)$, and $\|a+\rho bX\|_q\le\|a+bX\|_p$ for all $a,b\in\bbr$.
\end{theorem}
